rejected_rule.statement: A respondent cannot raise an objection to a decree under section 772 of the Civil Procedure Code if he fails to give seven days' notice in writing of such objection.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: This point had already been clarified by this Court in Ratwatte v Gunasekera (1987) 2 Sri L.R. 260, where Sharvananda CJ, in view of the contention that the plaintiffs in that particular instance had failed to comply with the provisions of section 772(1) of the Civil Procedure Code, said \
